label: D2 after choosing a2, early-to-mid episode (a2-commitment update)
explanation: Update gate z21 is active almost only at D2 steps (92% of mass) where the agent just chose a2 (in_action == 2 input; 99.9% of activations have action == 2, essentially never after a1), plus a small GO component (8% of mass) on upcoming-a2 trials after an unrewarded D1. Activation mass is concentrated on S2 being reached (common a2) but rare S1 also fires weakly. Strong episode-time dependence: rate ~10% for trials 3-49, falling to ~0 after trial ~60 and never on trials 0-2. Within a2 D2 steps it is further concentrated where the policy logit strongly favors a2 (choice < -4.44) and value is high (value > 8.1 lift 6.5x); magnitude tends to build over consecutive a2 trials. Never fires at D1 or when reward input is 1. Phase+action alone gives F1 0.41 (recall 0.91); adding ep_trial < 50 gives 0.66; adding the model own a2 policy logit gives dev F1 0.74 (mass recall 0.87). All variables used are observed at D2 (action is known from the input) or internal to the model; ep_trial is not an input but the agent could track it. Recorded the choice-logit version.
